Bash(ruby -e "
total_overdue = 5940
cards_per_day = 100
new_cards_per_day = 10
net_progress = cards_per_day - new_cards_per_day

days_needed = (total_overdue.to_f / net_progress).ceil
target_date = Date.today + days_needed

puts ''='' * 70
puts ''CALCULATION: When will you have 0 overdue cards?''
puts ''='' * 70
puts ''''
puts ''Current Status:''
puts ""  Total overdue cards: #{total_overdue}""
puts ""  Cards studied per day: #{cards_per_day}""
puts ""  New cards per day: #{new_cards_per_day}""
puts ""  Net progress per day: #{net_progress} cards""
puts ''''
puts ''='' * 70
puts ''RESULT:''
puts ""  Days needed: #{days_needed} days""
puts ""  Target date: #{target_date.strftime(''%Y-%m-%d (%A, %B %d)'')}""
puts ''='' * 70
puts ''''
puts ''Calculation: #{total_overdue} ÷ #{net_progress} = #{days_needed} days''
")
